policies: A record is visible only when its available_at_ist is not later than the simulated click.
Do not infer an earlier event timestamp from later reporting.
Date-only or timezone-ambiguous items remain excluded or deferred.
Reuters market-reaction stories are stored at publication time and are not backdated to the underlying event.
EIA WPSR is represented at its official scheduled release time; August 2026 10:30 a.m. ET corresponds to 20:00 IST.
No headline is assigned a retrospective bullish or bearish label.
An expectation is pre-release usable only when its timestamp is strictly earlier than the official release; at-release estimates are audit-only.
Multiple expectation sources are retained instead of cherry-picking a consensus after seeing the outcome.

deferred_or_excluded.item: U.S. Treasury Operation Economic Outcast release
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Official release date was verified but an exact intraday publication time was not exposed by the retrieved official page; it must not be backdated into click-time replay.
